business_problem: Zyte needed to launch an AI-enabled web data extraction service quickly, with low-latency streaming and minimal operational overhead, while a small distributed team moved core infrastructure to the cloud.
solution_summary: Zyte built its AutoExtract service on Confluent Cloud running alongside Google Cloud infrastructure to turn web crawling into a scalable event-driven extraction pipeline. Web crawlers act as Kafka producers, publishing raw page data into the streaming platform, while downstream AI and machine learning consumers transform that content into structured outputs for customers. The managed service let Zyte stand up a production-ready Kafka environment without spending weeks on cluster operations, and its cloud-vendor-aware deployment kept the Kafka cluster in the same availability zone as the rest of the application to minimize latency. Confluent Cloud also fit neatly with the team's use of Google Compute Engine and Google Cloud SQL, giving a globally distributed engineering team reliable data delivery, faster release cycles, and a stable backbone for AI-powered extraction at scale.

solution_components.name: Confluent Cloud
solution_components.role: Carries Zyte's event streams between web crawlers and downstream AI extraction services.

solution_components.name: Google Compute Engine
solution_components.role: Hosts the cloud application components that run alongside the managed Kafka cluster.

solution_components.name: Google Cloud SQL
solution_components.role: Provides a managed data service used as part of Zyte's cloud-based AutoExtract platform.

data_flow: Web crawlers publish page data into Confluent Cloud, AI and machine learning consumers transform the content into structured results, and Zyte then delivers those outputs back to customers through channels such as FTP, AWS S3, and Google Cloud Storage.
business_outcome: Zyte launched AutoExtract quickly, achieved stable low-latency operation with no outages after launch, and gave its remote team a managed streaming foundation that sped time to market for AI-powered data extraction.
architecture_clues: Kafka producers are web crawlers and consumers are AI and machine learning models.
Zyte kept the Kafka cluster in the same availability zone as the rest of the infrastructure to reduce latency.
The team paired Confluent Cloud with other managed Google Cloud services to minimize maintenance work.
